sara: Heads-up: noticing occasional 413s for embeddings where preflight estimated OK. pattern: preflight_estimate_bytes ~490KB, runtime_actual_bytes ~610KB. routing still picks large model but runtime rejects.
mike: do we have a reproducible sample? any common SDK/header variants?
sara: many callers use X-Embed-Meta or X-Client-Meta interchangeably. but the core problem looks estimator drift.
oliver: idea: run the preflight estimator in "shadow" at runtime (same inputs) to produce runtime_estimate_bytes and drift_score = (runtime_actual - preflight_estimate)/preflight_estimate. emit both as telemetry and attach sampled_digest to join traces.
tanya: I like shadow runs for visibility. keep in mind perf cost. we can sample 1% of traffic and run cheap estimator (no allocations) — just the same heuristic.
sara: shadow run telemetry would let us compute estimator_drift_rate and surface problematic payload shapes. could drive a dashboard heatmap by client_id_hash + model.\olmike: (typo) oliver: propose fields: preflight_estimate, runtime_estimate_shadow, runtime_actual, estimator_version, preflight_hash, sampled_digest. All opaque/hashes for privacy. console should show drift_percent and a sparklines tile.
tanya: also propose an alert rule: estimator_drift_rate > 0.1 for > 0.1% of requests in 1h OR > 200 requests. threshold conservative.
infra-bot: deploy 1715020020 by mike: enable estimator-shadow telemetry + sampled_digest -> staging
sara: also need an ingress normalization: map X-Embed-Meta / X-Client-Meta -> X-Embed-Meta (canonical) so routing policies get consistent keys.
oliver: for immediate UX, console add a tiny panel on route page: "Estimator drift (24h)" with heatmap and top offending client hashes. truncate client hashes to 8 chars.
mike: adding a flag estimator_shadow=true and sample_rate=0.01. will also add a metric estimator_drift_histogram and counter estimator_drift_alerts.
tanya: we should avoid surfacing raw header content anywhere. console gets only hashed ids + coarse routing_key (e.g., tier=pro/ent).
sara: operational ask: run canary 2h at 10% sampling to gather more signals for next-week model version bump.\mike: scheduling prod-canary 02:00-04:00 UTC with sample_rate=0.1, will tag traces canary=estimator_shadow.
infra-bot: deploy 1715020055 by mike: estimator-shadow -> prod-canary (10%)
